# onetsolutions_tlds (Data Source)

Lists the domain extensions on sale, with their prices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every extension open to registration, with its one-year price.
data "onetsolutions_tlds" "open" {
  registration_available = true
}

output "one_year_prices" {
  value = {
    for t in data.onetsolutions_tlds.open.tlds :
    t.tld => one([for p in t.pricing : p.registration_price if p.years == 1])
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Only the extensions of this category: `generic`, `country` or `new`.
- `registration_available` (Boolean) When set, only the extensions whose registration is (`true`) or is not (`false`) open.
- `tld` (String) Only the extension with this name, without its leading dot, such as `fr`.

### Read-Only

- `tlds` (Attributes List) The extensions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tlds))

<a id="nestedatt--tlds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tlds`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) `generic`, `country`, `new` or `premium`.
- `display_name` (String) Its display name.
- `max_registration_years` (Number) The longest registration length, in years.
- `min_registration_years` (Number) The shortest registration length, in years.
- `pricing` (Attributes List) Its prices per registration length, in EUR, as decimal strings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tlds--pricing))
- `registration_available` (Boolean) Whether new names can be registered in it.
- `tld` (String) The extension, without its leading dot, such as `com`.
- `transfer_available` (Boolean) Whether its domains can be transferred in.
- `transfer_lock_available` (Boolean) Whether its domains can be locked against transfers.
- `whois_privacy_available` (Boolean) Whether WHOIS privacy can be enabled on its domains.
- `whois_privacy_price` (String) The price of WHOIS privacy, in EUR, as a decimal string.

<a id="nestedatt--tlds--pricing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tlds.pricing`

Read-Only:

- `registration_price` (String) The price of a registration.
- `renewal_price` (String) The price of a renewal.
- `transfer_price` (String) The price of a transfer in.
- `years` (Number) The registration length, in years.
